name: codeatlas-ai
description: CodeAtlas AI — AI-powered Code Intelligence Platform with RAG, AST parsing, and semantic search

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,workers,frontend -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w workers" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w parser && npm run build -w embedding-service && npm run build -w vector-service && npm run build -w ai-service && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w workers && npm run build -w frontend
